contributor: ChatGPT (GPT-6 Astra Pro), delegated ordinary-control implementer
ordinary_probability: Same six binary public experts and fixed-mass NumericProd update as the candidate, one uniform selected paid query per block, block-frozen forecasts, greedy marginal expected-cost action, no randomized-action regret theorem claim.
ordinary_combo: Full-key paid cache; one selected label per block obtained from cache or own cold DPLL; optional unselected capped DPLL probes (which include cheap checked contradictions) and optional full DPLL according to declared public-shape/prior-successful-cost estimate versus estimated error cost. Actual chosen acquisition costs retained. Additional obtained labels update only at block boundary. No selected-quota or lottery theorem claimed.
selection_and_prices: Parameters and tape supplied before run. Common error price plus optional separate false-positive/false-negative prices. Unit price multiplies the full same common resource invoice. Prices may change by running a new explicitly labeled method execution; fixed-path replay is separately identified.
cost_estimate: Cold default is the public shape proxy. Once a shape class has completed paid full DPLL calls, use its historical arithmetic-mean completion cost. Failed and capped-probe calls remain censored and never lower this completion estimate.
quick_probe_cap: min(public full cap, 2048 + 24 * query.key_words). Unselected probe attempted only if its maximum unit-price bill is below current estimated error cost; its no-answer result remains unresolved and its cost is retained.
focused_test_population: Handwritten four/eight-query tiny tapes only, with true/false/repeated/version-changed formulas, and hand-selected price/cap/budget edge cases. No full generated cohort comparison in delegated work.
private_evaluator: No true labels supplied to run_method or read by any policy; reference truth used only by a separate focused test runner.
output: Immutable pre-computation base/emitted probability and prospective action; separate post-computation terminal action/status, selected/cached/purchased fields, every provider invoice, actual paid feedback and complete episode meter. Common installed source bill is excluded symmetrically and disclosed.
boundaries: DEVELOPMENT only, no final freeze, no full cohort method comparison, no principal-clock credit, no commit/push.
